source: Independent TF2 and Classified menu pages and feature registries. Edition-specific controls are labeled; this catalog describes implemented controls, not complete native gameplay acceptance.

items.label: Aimbot
items.desc: Enable this aim profile.

items.label: Aim key
items.desc: Choose the activation key and Hold, Toggle or Always mode.

items.label: Aim mode
items.desc: Choose Camera or Silent aim.

items.label: Aim FOV
items.desc: Set the target selection angle from 0.1 to 180 degrees.

items.label: Aim range
items.desc: Limit target distance from 1 to 500 metres.

items.label: Smoothing
items.desc: Adjust camera smoothing from 1 to 40.

items.label: Auto fire
items.desc: Fire automatically while the aim conditions are met.

items.label: FOV circle
items.desc: Show the selected aim angle as an overlay.

items.label: Aim snapline
items.desc: Draw a line to the selected target.

items.label: Hitbox
items.desc: Choose Head, Chest, Stomach, individual limbs, Upper body or Nearest.

items.label: Visible only
items.desc: Filter target selection by visibility.

items.label: Target buildings
items.desc: Include recognized buildings.

items.label: Ignore cloaked
items.desc: Exclude cloaked targets.

items.label: Ignore disguised
items.desc: Exclude disguised targets.

items.label: Ignore invulnerable
items.desc: Exclude invulnerable targets.

items.label: Projectile aim
items.desc: Enable prediction for supported projectile weapons in the standard Aimbot profile editor.

items.label: Prediction time
items.desc: Adjust the projectile prediction time limit in the standard Aimbot profile editor.

items.label: Triggerbot
items.desc: Enable this trigger profile.

items.label: Trigger key
items.desc: Use a separate activation key and mode.

items.label: Hitgroup
items.desc: Select a body group, Upper body or All.

items.label: Trigger delay
items.desc: Set the firing delay from 0 to 1 second.

items.label: Trigger range
items.desc: Limit range from 1 to 500 metres.

items.label: Class preview
items.desc: Choose a class model to preview your visual settings.

items.label: Team preview
items.desc: Preview the available team appearances for the selected edition.

items.label: Rotate and zoom
items.desc: Rotate and zoom the class model; reset the view to its default pose.

items.label: Class selector
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Browse the installed class catalog.

items.label: Weapon appearances
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Select a supported weapon model skin family from the image catalog.

items.label: Player appearances
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Select supported class-model skin families.

items.label: Restore original
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Return an appearance selection to its original model skin.

items.label: Cosmetic slots
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Equip up to three local cosmetic appearances, with supported styles, paint and team colors.

items.label: Class loadout preview
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Preview all nine classes with a stock held weapon and selected cosmetics. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom and double-click to reset.

items.label: Player appearance tile
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Open the skin picker from the Player tile and preview the selected appearance on the class model.

items.label: Item catalog
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Search installed weapons, cosmetics, taunts, cases, keys, tools, war paints and crafting items.

items.label: Local item copies
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Create distinct local copies and duplicates, then edit or remove each copy.

items.label: Item customization
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Set supported quality, level, paint, wear, style and custom name fields.

items.label: Class loadouts
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Equip eligible items in class weapon, cosmetic and taunt slots.

items.label: Native backpack
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Show local copies in the native backpack during supported main-menu and local listen-server sessions. This does not create Steam ownership or enable trading, crafting or case redemption.

items.label: Inventory profiles
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Save local copies and equipment with the selected profile and Auto Save preference.

items.label: Inventory restoration
items.desc: Retail TF2 only. Stop or Capture Protection removes injected copies and restores the original native loadout lookup.

items.label: Bunny hop
items.desc: Enable the host bunny-hop control.

items.label: Auto strafe
items.desc: Enable the host air-strafe control.

items.label: Preserve Scout air jump
items.desc: Keep Scout air-jump input while bunny hop is enabled.

items.label: Strafe direction
items.desc: Choose View / mouse or Movement keys as the auto-strafe direction.

items.label: Heavy rev-jump
items.desc: Add one jump on a fresh secondary-attack press while a grounded Heavy holds an idle minigun.

items.label: Pre-speed
items.desc: With Auto strafe enabled, briefly accelerate before takeoff when holding Jump from a stationary position.

items.label: Camera FOV
items.desc: Set the camera field of view from 60 to 130 degrees.

items.label: Model FOV
items.desc: Set the viewmodel field of view from 40 to 140 degrees.

items.label: Model offsets
items.desc: Both editions: adjust X, Y and Z position and Pitch, Yaw and Roll.

items.label: Third person
items.desc: Toggle the third-person camera; the default binding is F5.

items.label: Camera distance
items.desc: Adjust camera distance from 30 to 400 Source units.

items.label: Shoulder offset
items.desc: Adjust the shoulder offset from -64 to 64 Source units.

items.label: Height offset
items.desc: Adjust camera height from -64 to 64 Source units.

items.label: Camera collision
items.desc: Adjust the camera position around scene geometry.

items.label: First person while scoped
items.desc: Return to first person while scoped.

items.label: Swap shoulder
items.desc: Switch the camera shoulder; the default binding is V.

items.label: Free camera
items.desc: Fly the view with movement, Jump and Duck controls. Player movement and attack input are suppressed while active; the camera has no world collision.

items.label: Flight speed
items.desc: Set free-camera flight speed from 50 to 2000 units per second.

items.label: Speed multiplier
items.desc: Use the Speed action to multiply flight speed by 1 to 5.

items.label: Lua editor
items.desc: Create and edit scripts inside the interface.

items.label: Script manager
items.desc: Refresh, run and stop individual Lua scripts.

items.label: Lua console
items.desc: Read script output, callback errors and diagnostics.

items.label: TF2 API
items.desc: API 1.2: copied player/entity data, active weapons, conditions, projections, vector/tick helpers, feature metadata and capture-aware controls.

items.label: Custom UI
items.desc: Add tabs, controls and overlays with the shared UI API.

items.label: Saved profiles
items.desc: Save and reload your settings in each edition.

items.label: Hotkeys
items.desc: Assign keys with Hold, Toggle and Always activation modes.

items.label: Feature search
items.desc: Find registered controls from the menu search.

items.label: Favorites
items.desc: Keep frequently used controls together.

items.label: Interface and overlay scale

items.label: Radar
items.desc: Display recognized entities in a radar overlay.

items.label: Keybind overlay
items.desc: Keep active bindings visible on screen.

items.label: Watermark
items.desc: Show the configured profile and frame information.

items.label: Active features overlay
items.desc: Show enabled features as compact labels and drag them while the menu is open.

items.label: Stop
items.desc: Stop the active module through its session control.

items.label: Capture Protection
items.desc: Disable and lock protected visual and scene features, including free camera. Restore native inventory objects when enabled.

items.label: Menu layouts
items.desc: Choose either supported interface layout while keeping the same saved features.

items.label: 23 downloadable languages
items.desc: Download or update language packs in-game. English is included and locally edited translations are preserved.

items.label: Themes and colors
items.desc: Customize the interface theme, accent colors and background.

items.label: Custom image and logo
items.desc: Use the interface image and logo controls to personalize the menu.
